messages:
Elena Park: Quick update for Private/VPC customers: we're shipping a Data Sovereignty toggle in the next bundle. It enforces regional S3 targets and blocks cross-region exports by default. Rolling invites start next Tue. :globe_with_meridians:
Roberto Silva: Ops note: for on-prem installs the toggle maps to the installer flag --enforce-residency and a controller policy. Example: 
```
./installer --mode private --enforce-residency=eu-west-1
```
Kayla M.: Security: toggle also locks down export routes until a scoped admin enables them; audit events are generated for any change. Will add sample IAM policy to the runbook.
Elena Park: Customer comms draft: "New: Data Sovereignty toggle to keep audit logs and exports inside your chosen region by default. Contact your CSM to enable cross-region exports." Short, clear.
infra-bot: Internal rollout schedule: staging 1950190000, prod cohorts start 1950774400. Runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/private-data-sovereignty (WIP).
Roberto Silva: Action items: 1) Eng: validate installer flag in air-gapped bundles (Roberto) 2) Sec: add IAM examples & attestation checklist (Kayla) 3) CSM/Marketing: prep customer note after runbook final. Ping when done.
Elena Park: Thanks all 44d. Please review runbook tonight.
